subject: Offer approval requested: L5 Backend - Oliver Ng
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Offer approval requested: L5 Backend - Oliver Ng

Team —

Interview loop finished last week and Oliver Ng (ex-Finbank) finished a strong onsite for L5 Backend (service mesh + infra scale). Hiring manager recommends moving forward. Below is the comp proposal coming from the hiring team; requesting sign-off so HR can generate the offer.

Candidate expectations (verbal): base $250,000, 15% target bonus, prefers higher cash but OK with equity uplift. Wants close-to-market RSU given competing offers.

Proposed package (internal rec):
- Base: $245,000
- Target bonus: 15%
- RSU: $200,000 4-yr cliff/annual (standard Redwood schedule)
- Sign-on: $25,000 (pro-rated)

Notes: hiring manager asks for a competitive RSU line to beat the primary competitor. Headcount is approved for Q4 SDE hiring bucket (code 4-BACKEND-2026). Attached: draft offer letter + comp grid.

Ask: Karthik — can you confirm this fits within the L5 band and pricing guardrails? Marissa — if green, please prepare DocuSign for a 5-business-day acceptance window. Laura — budget owner awareness.

Thanks,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Sr. Engineering Manager, Backend
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Offer approval requested: L5 Backend - Oliver Ng

Sergio —

Thanks for the summary. Quick read of the comp grid: base at $245k sits slightly above midpoint but within band (L5 band: 190–260k). RSU $200k is at the upper quartile; sign-on $25k is reasonable given counter offers. A couple of small asks before I mark final:

1) Please confirm the proposed on-target earnings (OTE) you want to represent in external communications (we should avoid showing total including RSUs unless candidate asks).
2) If we go to $200k RSU, we should document business justification (competitive counter + critical infra hire) for compensation audit trail.

If you want to reduce cash pressure, we could shift $10k from base to RSU, but manager preference is to keep base higher. From my side, I can approve the package contingent on receipt of the justification note.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Total Rewards
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Offer approval requested: L5 Backend - Oliver Ng

Hi team —

I've drafted the offer letter and attached the comp grid for the L5 band. A few operational notes:

- Offer draft attached (offer_draft_oliver_ng.pdf) — it reflects base $245k, 15% bonus, $200k RSU over 4 years, $25k sign-on paid in two installments (30/60 days).
- If Karthik approves the justification thread, I will create the DocuSign envelope and lock acceptance window to 5 business days.
- Please confirm the start date target (we currently have a tentative 2027-01-10). If the manager wants an earlier start, we may need to adjust pro-rata sign-on and first payroll cycle.

I also included a short justification template at the top of the comp grid to help with the audit. If you approve, I will route for final signatures and send to the candidate + BrightBridge recruiter.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference

Sergio / team —

Budget owner here. Q4 hiring bucket can absorb this hire and the uplift to RSU is approved given the business priority (service-scaling work). Confirmed start date of 2027-01-10 is fine.

Marissa — proceed to send the DocuSign when Karthik signs off on the justification note. Please ensure to include the standard new-hire manager onboarding checklist in the offer packet.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Engineering Programs
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Offer approval requested: L5 Backend - Oliver Ng

Thanks all —

I confirm the business justification: Oliver would be the technical lead for our cache re-architecture; losing him to the competitor will materially slow the project and increase infra spend. I'll paste a one-paragraph justification here for the comp audit: 

"Candidate brings 7 years of high-scale backend and cache-invalidation experience from Finbank; expected to deliver 3x throughput improvements on the cache tier within 9 months. This hire is critical to the Q2 2027 latency and cost objectives and warrants an upper-quartile RSU package to secure acceptance."

Karthik — with that, please mark approved and Marissa, please send via DocuSign (link to envelope will be helpful). Target to have signed offer in hand by EOD Monday.

Sergio
